decision_metadata.llm_rationale: Regime concentration is triggered at 93.85% Bull (61/65, well above the 0.80 threshold) AND the UP_TRI×Bull×Bank cell hits the 0.20 cell threshold exactly (13/65 = 20.0%). UP_TRI also dominates signal mix at 63/65 = 96.9% (above 0.85). Matched Bull×UP_TRI cohort sits only at Candidate tier (n=86) — unvalidated edge across all concentration axes, so the dual regime + signal-type monoculture is unvalidated exposure, not validated edge.
